author: PieZ
body:
Hello Avicadians (Deal with it)

On Saturday January 28th at midnight EST, I will be hosting an Anime Night. The anime night will be one movie and if we have more time, two episodes of a show. We will also be watching the anime in English dubbed for anyone that is new to anime and would like to try it out. Do not worry, we are showing anime which the dubs are not that bad. Hopefully. 

Our lineup for that night will start with Summer Wars. If people are staying after that we will finish the night with an episode or two of Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood. 

If anyone is interested in this event, please say below you are interested and we will meet on Teamspeak at the time.
